info.title: HRManagement
info.description: HR Management API for querying and managing employees, departments, and projects with flattened schema optimized for Amazon Q Business agents

get.description: Return a list of all employees with their name, department, job title, salary, bonus, employment status, hire date, email, skills, certifications, and manager. Use this to browse the full employee directory or when the user asks about employees without specifying a particular person.

post.description: Create a new employee record. Requires the employee name, department, job title, salary, and status. Use this when the user wants to add or register a new employee.

employee_name.description: Full name of the new employee

email.description: Work email address of the employee

department_name.description: Department the employee will belong to

department_location.description: Office location of the department, for example San Francisco, New York, Chicago

job_title.description: Job title or role of the new employee

employment_status.description: Whether the employee is currently active or inactive

hire_date.description: The employee start date in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

contract_end_date.description: The last day of the employee contract in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), or leave empty if still active

skills.description: Comma-separated list of employee skills, for example Python, AWS, Docker

certifications.description: Comma-separated list of professional certifications with dates, for example AWS Solutions Architect (2022-05-10), CKA (2023-01-20)

manager_name.description: Full name of the employee direct manager, or leave empty if none

get.description: Return details of a single employee by their unique ID including department, salary, bonus, skills, certifications, and manager. Use this when the user asks about a specific employee and you know their ID. If you do not know the ID, use GetAllEmployees first.

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of the employee to retrieve

get.description: Return a list of all departments with their name, headcount, annual budget, amount spent, department head, office location, and sub-teams. Use this to browse the full department directory or when the user asks about departments without specifying a particular one.

Return details of a single department by its unique ID including headcount, budget, department head, location, and sub-teams. Use this when the user asks about a specific department and you know the ID. If you do not know the ID, use GetAllDepartments first.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of the department to retrieve

get.description: Return a list of all projects with their name, owning department, status, start and end dates, budget, amount spent, project lead, milestones, and team members. Use this to browse all projects or when the user asks about project status or budgets.

Return details of a single project by its unique ID including status, dates, budget, lead, milestones, and team members. Use this when the user asks about a specific project and you know the ID. If you do not know the ID, use GetAllProjects first.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of the project to retrieve

Employee.description: An employee record with flattened fields for optimal Q Business agent accuracy

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the employee

email.description: Work email address of the employee

department_name.description: Name of the department the employee belongs to

department_location.description: Office location of the employee department

job_title.description: Current job title or role of the employee

employment_status.description: Whether the employee is currently Active or Inactive

hire_date.description: The date the employee was hired in ISO-8601 format

contract_end_date.description: The last day of the employee contract in ISO-8601 format, or null if still active

manager_name.description: Full name of the employee direct manager, or null if none

skills.description: Comma-separated list of the employee skills, for example Python, AWS, Docker

certifications.description: Comma-separated list of professional certifications with dates, for example AWS Solutions Architect (2022-05-10)

Department.description: A department record with flattened fields for optimal Q Business agent accuracy

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the department

headcount.description: Total number of employees in the department

annual_budget.description: Total annual operating budget of the department in USD

budget_spent.description: Amount of budget spent so far in USD

department_head_name.description: Full name of the person leading the department

department_head_email.description: Email address of the department head

city.description: City where the department office is located

state.description: State where the department office is located

country.description: Country where the department office is located

sub_teams.description: Comma-separated list of sub-teams within the department, for example Backend, Frontend, DevOps

Project.description: A project record with flattened fields for optimal Q Business agent accuracy

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the project

department_name.description: Name of the department that owns the project

start_date.description: Project start date in ISO-8601 format

end_date.description: Project end date in ISO-8601 format

budget_allocated.description: Total budget allocated to the project in USD

budget_spent.description: Amount of project budget spent so far in USD

project_lead_name.description: Full name of the person leading the project

milestones.description: Comma-separated list of project milestones with status, for example Phase 1 - Assessment (Completed), Phase 2 - Migration (InProgress)

team_member_count.description: Number of team members assigned to the project
